rules.name: Core Courses
rules.desc: Majors must take these courses at a minimum of four units each.

rules.name: Oral Proficiency Interview (OPI)
rules.notes: In addition to the course requirements for the major, students must also take an Oral Proficiency Interview (OPI) in Spanish two quarters before degree conferral through the Stanford Language Center.

rules.desc:
Students should use electives to reach the unit minimum requirement to complete the major.

• Coursework within the department. Additional 100- or 200-level ILAC courses. If the course is taught in a language other than Spanish, written work must be completed in Spanish, as appropriate.

• Language coursework. Up to three courses of SPANLANG at the second year level or above, excluding conversation courses. “Spanish Through” courses do not count against this limit.

• Bing Overseas Study Program. Up to 15 units of pre-approved coursework from Stanford study abroad programs in Santiago or Madrid. A course abroad taught by a core member of the ILAC faculty does not count against this limit. Consult with the DLCL SSO or ILAC DUS to confirm pre-approved courses.

• Coursework outside the department. Up to 5 units of pre-approved coursework from outside ILAC can be contributed to the degree.

This gateway to the major is usually taken by the end of sophomore year. It introduces literature and its distinctions from other modes of linguistic expression and a fundamental set of interpretive skills.
Majors must take one of these courses for a minimum of four units.

The Capstone course is designed as a culmination of the major while reflecting the nature of the discipline and the role of the Spanish language in society. Topics vary per year. It is open to other students, except frosh and sophomores.
Majors should take the course for at least four units.

Students majoring in any DLCL department (i.e., Comparative Literature, French and Italian, German Studies, Iberian and Latin American Cultures, and Slavic Languages and Literatures) who have an overall grade point average (GPA) of 3.3 or above and who maintain a 3.5 (GPA) in their major courses, are eligible to participate in the DLCL’s honors program.
See the Honors webpage for more information.
Program Requirements
To earn honors, students must complete a minimum of 9 units (3 units per quarter), submit a thesis, and present at the Honors Colloquium at the end of their senior year.
